evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: This describes one feature (create a game); the listed fields are attributes of that feature, not separate implementable features.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: inviting estimators via a URL; no independent feature combined.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: One feature (start a round by entering an item); the input method is an attribute, not an independent feature.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing all items for the session; the purpose clause does not add another implementable feature.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selecting an item (whether for initial estimate or re-estimate) is one feature; 're-estimated' is a mode of the same action.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: adding an item; the justification explains why but does not introduce another feature.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: One feature: editing an item; no independent features combined.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: deleting an item; not combining multiple implementable features.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: One feature: immediately revealing existing estimates; the condition about not all estimators is part of the same behavior.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: accepting the average; no separate independently implementable requirement present.

evaluations.evidence: have the "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Single conditional feature: auto-fill estimate when all cards match; not multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: One feature: entering the agreed estimate; no additional independent feature combined.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: re-estimating a previously estimated story; a specific use case of estimation rather than a second feature.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: One feature: import from spreadsheet; the purpose clause does not add a separate feature.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: copy/paste bulk stories; not combined with another independent feature.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: One feature: browsing previous games; no multiple independent actions included.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing a transcript; not combined with another distinct implementable feature.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: One feature: HTML export; format-specific exports are separate stories where needed, so this is atomic.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: CSV export; atomic and focused on one output format.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: One feature: deleting a game and its stored data; not combining multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... by entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: account creation; listed required fields are attributes of that feature rather than separate features.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: logging in; credentials are part of the same feature.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: One feature: updating account details; doesn't combine multiple independently implementable features.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: account deletion (and associated data removal); not multiple features.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: One feature: local timezone display; no independent features combined.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: password reminder via email; not combined with other independent functionality.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: One feature: selecting an estimation scale (option set); enumerating options does not create multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: setting an invitation limit; not combining multiple implementable features.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: One feature: joining a game using the provided link and entering name; not multiple features.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing the current item; no additional independent feature included.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: One feature: viewing the session's item list; not combining separate implementable features.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: immediate visibility of who has estimated; atomic behavior.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: One feature: synchronized reveal of estimates; condition (after all have given) is part of the same feature.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: allowing estimate changes until reveal; not multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: One feature: display of prior estimates per estimator for the current story; atomic.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: attribution of estimates in current round; not combining independent features.

evaluations.evidence: be able start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: One feature: starting a shared two-minute timer; no separate implementable features combined.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: automatic reset behavior for the timer; a specific behavior of the timer rather than a separate feature.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: scrolling through prior rounds; not combining multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: One feature: consistent card ordering across draws; atomic requirement.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: changing estimate until draw completion; not multiple features.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: One feature: show thumbnail near played cards; single UI feature.

evaluations.evidence: have written a site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: compliance with specified web standards; not combining distinct features.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: One feature: maintain a glossary; atomic requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Single developer task: creating indexes to improve query performance; not multiple separate features.

evaluations.evidence: have the application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: This is one cross-browser compatibility requirement that lists target browsers; it specifies a single feature (browser support) rather than combining unrelated features.

evaluations.evidence: have the site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: accessibility compliance; not multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: One feature: application responsiveness (performance); not combining independent features.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: Unicode support for internationalization; atomic requirement.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: One feature: user-friendly URLs; not combining multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: friendly error pages; not multiple implementable features combined.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: One feature: anonymized storage of results; a single privacy requirement.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: view usage metrics for the game; not combining multiple independent features.
